user_scenario_agent_activity_summary: 1.  Agent navigated to the "Boards" page within the "demo-project".
2.  To address the first scenario (`BRD-Create`), the agent initiated the board creation process by clicking the "Create new board" button.
3.  Agent entered the board name "Automated board 1234" and finalized its creation.
4.  On the newly created board's page, the agent added a list with the name "Automated List <rand4>".
5.  Agent returned to the main "Boards" page and performed an extraction to verify the new board was present.
6.  To address the second scenario (`BRD-Create-Delete`), the agent again initiated the board creation process.
7.  Agent entered the board name "Automated board for deletion" and created the board.
8.  Agent returned to the main "Boards" page.
9.  Agent located the board named "Automated board for deletion" and clicked the delete button.
10. Agent performed a final extraction to verify the board was successfully removed from the page.
